Statistics are built from two files next to the script: TextTools.log — how many times each action ran, TextTools_usage.log — how many tokens and how much money went to each model.

Empty so far: usage is recorded starting from the version that introduced this report.
The cost is an **estimate**. The token counts are exact: the API returns them in the usage field.
Prices come from the OpenRouter catalogue (/api/v1/models), because OpenAI has no public price endpoint.
Catalogue downloaded %1$s, refreshed at most once a day.
Differences from the provider’s own invoice are possible.
For some models no price was found in the catalogue — they are left out of the total (marked with a plus).
Only request counts, model ids, durations and text lengths are stored. No request text is saved. Time covers the provider call only.

Hourly aggregates only: counts, models, durations, text lengths and tokens. Request texts are never sent. External delivery depends on the server accepting Sentry metrics; flushing the SDK is not a delivery acknowledgement.
